info.title: Open Keylight Chroma local API
info.description: Contract for the original ESP application, reviewed against the handlers. This is not a hardware qualification or release claim. HTTP uses port 80 on a trusted LAN; no TLS listener or cross-origin API. Host must be the device IP, hostname, hostname.local, or setup IP 192.168.4.1, optionally followed by :80. If supplied, Origin must equal http:// plus the exact Host value. API routes accept no query parameters. Public reads expose metadata; mutations and client listing require a paired bearer token, except POST /pair. JSON bodies are 1–2048 bytes, read within 10 seconds; malformed, duplicate or unknown fields and NUL are rejected. String limits are UTF-8 byte limits, recorded by x-maxUtf8Bytes and x-minUtf8Bytes. JSON replies use Cache-Control: no-store and Connection: close. Errors can follow partial hardware/update work; do not infer that a failed command restored the previous state.

host.description: Replace with this device hostname or IPv4 address.

get.description: Public LAN metadata. Capabilities describe the running implementation; do not infer absent features. Controller connectivity is independent of Wi-Fi connectivity.

get.summary: Read desired state and controller evidence
get.description: Returns desired intent and the most recent controller report. reported.valid plus confirmed_fields describe getter evidence; operation.status alone does not confirm an active effect RGB value. A pending command may coexist with an older report. Refresh after a 202 response and compare the requested fields before treating a change as confirmed.

200.description: Read desired state and controller evidence

patch.description: 202 accepts intent; it does not confirm output. expected_revision must match the global revision from GET /state, or 409 is returned without applying that patch. Every accepted patch increments revision, including lock-only changes. Recording Lock rejects output changes except Off; unlock in a separate request. OTA in progress returns 503 except for exactly {power:false}. Never blindly retry a timed-out mutation. White-mode transitions are not rendered even though transition_ms is stored. Output changes return 503 while controller.ready is false; lock-only changes remain available.

get.description: At most 32 volatile events, newest first. Includes accepted, failed and getter-confirmed controller operations; resets on application restart.

post.summary: Issue one client token inside an open pairing window
post.description: Body is exactly one nonempty label of at most 32 UTF-8 bytes. A physical three-second hold or authenticated POST /pairing opens a 180-second window consumed by one successful pairing. Four clients maximum; an application with no clients opens its initial window. Closed window, full capacity or token persistence failure returns 403. The token is returned only once.

Reconnect and inspect settings rather than assuming reboot succeeded. SSID and all passwords are omitted from the response. Update in progress returns 409. No expected_revision field is supported here.

post.summary: Persist acceptance of this application trial
post.description: No body is needed. Authenticated confirmation persists acceptance of this exact application image. A pending trial lasts 180 seconds after application initialization; confirmation and expiry select one terminal decision. Already confirmed is idempotent. Expired, failed, uninitialized or concurrent confirmation returns 503. The retained bootloader has no automatic crash rollback: application fallback requires its code/task to execute. Do not confirm before checking identity, networking and controller operation.

200.description: Persist acceptance of this application trial

post.summary: Verify an application image and schedule reboot
post.description: Application-only OTA into the existing inactive ESP slot. Requires a confirmed current trial and no concurrent upload, otherwise 409. Exact Content-Type application/octet-stream, known Content-Length of 288–1572864 bytes (also within the actual slot), lowercase X-SHA256 matching the full body, and ESP image validation are required. The total upload budget is 120 seconds. Failure schedules no reboot; the inactive slot may have been modified. Never upload a bootloader, partition table, NXP image or merged flash image. 202 schedules reboot; it does not prove the new image booted. Reconnect, verify identity and operation, then confirm its 180-second trial. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous response.

parameters.name: X-SHA256
parameters.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact complete application binary. This verifies integrity against the supplied digest, not publisher authenticity.

get.summary: Read the cached controller update job
get.description: Public LAN metadata. This endpoint does not probe SPI. Counters describe staging transfer and verification, not overall installation progress. completed requires a matching fresh application, typed controller confirmation and durable journal clearing. Recovery-required state never triggers an automatic retry or restore. There is no recovery/reset endpoint in this version.

post.description: Authenticated upload of a fixed 28,736-byte Open Keylight NXP package. Requires a confirmed ESP trial and an available supported controller. The whole package is received in RAM within 30 seconds and checked before queuing controller work. X-SHA256 covers the whole package; the internal header separately hashes its 28,672-byte bank. Metadata and hashes do not authenticate a publisher or establish hardware qualification. The worker turns the light off, verifies darkness, enters the loader once, verifies all 448 blocks, commits once, holds SPI quiet, then checks the new application. 202 only transfers ownership to a background job; poll GET for its outcome. Do not retry an ambiguous response automatically. Legacy migration requires exact 1.3.0.0 plus an observed supported part getter; ordinary stock firmware without that getter is not admitted.

parameters.name: X-SHA256
parameters.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the complete controller package, including its 64-byte header.

202.description: Package admitted to a worker job

BearerToken.description: Token returned once by POST /pair. Never place it in a URL.

Error.description: Request failed; inspect the error string. No success should be inferred.

Light.description: Logical light state. White mode requires effect none. transition_ms is a retained preference; the current worker renders color transitions only. RGB and brightness are control levels, not calibrated photometry.

StatePatch.description: At least one state field. RGB requires all three channels. Mode is explicit: RGB alone does not select color. Validation also checks the merged current state. White mode cannot use a non-none effect. Duplicate object keys are rejected. expected_revision is optional optimistic concurrency control.

SceneStatePatch.description: At least one state field, merged with factory defaults rather than the current light. recording_lock is cleared on save. Defaults: power off, white mode, 50% brightness, 4500 K, RGB 255/96/32, transition 600 ms, effect none, unlocked. expected_revision is not accepted.

State.description: desired is intent; reported is the last normalized controller snapshot. Use valid, confirmed_fields and operation together, then compare your requested values. Fields outside confirmed_fields can be retained preferences and are not getter-confirmed. A pending operation can coexist with an older valid report. Native RGB is unavailable during custom-frame rendering, so the report is invalidated. Controller levels and optical light output are different kinds of evidence.

password.description: Empty for an open network, otherwise 8–64 UTF-8 bytes; control characters are rejected.

uri.description: mqtt:// or mqtts:// with a DNS/IPv4 host and optional port 1–65535. No embedded credentials, path, query or IPv6 literal. Empty is allowed only when the resulting configuration is disabled. enabled and URI are validated together.

SettingsPatch.description: String limits are UTF-8 byte limits; x-maxUtf8Bytes records the firmware constraint. Control characters are rejected. Wi-Fi and MQTT changes schedule a restart; name/role-only changes do not. Fields omitted retain their previous values. Passwords are never returned.

token.description: Returned once; keep private. The device stores a SHA256 hash.

entries.description: Newest first; volatile bounded event history.

ready.description: Verified readiness for output commands; independent of basic controller connectivity.

part_id.description: Observed original-controller part ID; zero when unknown or using the legacy backend.

trial_confirmed.description: Original NXP startup trial state; not the separate ESP application trial.

last_health_ms.description: ESP uptime at the last validated lifecycle response; zero before validation.

controller.description: connected records communication; ready gates output. Only the supported original lighting role or explicitly supported legacy controller can be ready. Diagnostic and unsupported images do not permit lighting changes.
